CASE STUDY DATA

CASE STUDY DATA

PROFILE: POS SaaS Company · Since 2020 · Jakarta & Surabaya · 12 Salespeople

Stagnant acquisition despite strong retention — SQL-to-Closed stuck at <13%

ROOT CAUSE:
  • Talent mismatch — hired SaaS BDs who couldn't adapt to the company's sales dynamics
  • No consistent methodology, unclear KPIs, and no structured sales story or script
WHAT WE DID:
  • Built a new hiring & onboarding framework and trained HR to execute it
  • Established a replicable sales methodology with stronger value proposition & objection scripts
  • Redefined KPIs and ran weekly sales training for 3 months

THE CHANGES IN NUMBERS

13%
BEFORE — Conversion Rate
Stagnant at <10 closed clients/month
27%
AFTER — Conversion Rate
2× closed clients with half the headcount
PROFILE: D2C Online Accessories · Founded 2022 · TikTok & IG · Mid-Up Segment

Revenue flatlined 9 months despite growing social following — conversion <10%, repeat purchase 18%

ROOT CAUSE:
  • No structured customer journey from first touch to post-purchase — major upsell gap
  • CS team handling multiple apps with no SOP, especially for mid-up market customers
WHAT WE DID:
  • Full customer journey mapping + post-purchase WhatsApp series (day 30/60/90)
  • Introduced product bundling & "Complete the Look" upsell framework
  • Biweekly CS training for 6 weeks on sales communication & value delivery

THE CHANGES IN NUMBERS

10%
BEFORE — Conversion Rate
Repeat purchase 18%, basket size 300–500k
15%
AFTER — Conversion Rate
Repeat purchase 43%, basket size 400–600k
